Package persistence

Class Cache<V>

java.lang.Object
persistence.Cache<V>
public class Cache<V> extends Object
Implementation of a simple Cache 'WriteAllocate' with operations put, get, delete and exists. It is also implemented as a variant of a 'Copy Back' cache, with the difference it always writes an object to disk when it is to be replaced, as it does not track if the object has been modified. It implements persistCache(), which needs to be called **before** an instance of this class is to be destructed. The cache: - Writes to disk when an object is to be replaced. - Writes to disk when an object is deleted. - Writes to disk at most 'capacity' times when calling persistCache(). - Loads from disk when an object is to be getted or checked its existence, only when it's not previously in cache.
Author:
Artur Leivar (artur.leivar@estudiantat.upc.edu)
